outcomes: A gate session run on a developer machine or in a local agent session reaches Delivery under the developer's stored login, and a hosted run keeps reporting under its run credential
nonGoals: Turning reporting on by default. A developer selects the reporter with PUTNAMI_SESSION_REPORTER=@putnami/cloud
Reporting under the workspace machine token. The local mode withholds PUTNAMI_CLOUD_TOKEN and uses the stored login only
Changing the session's own verdict. A refused frame is recorded by the engine and changes nothing else

requirements.text: With no run credential from the handshake or the environment and no ingest base, the session reporter posts each frame to /v1/workspaces/{workspace}/ci/local-sessions/{sessionId} on the control plane of the linked workspace, with the run-session body and its three session headers, under the workspace token of the stored login of putnami cloud login. It refreshes that login the way workspace commands do, and re-mints it once on a 401.

A run credential from the handshake or the environment, an ingest base, or an opened handshake makes the reporter hosted. A hosted reporter posts to the ingest base under its run credential, or answers reporter_not_configured when one of the two is missing, and never reads the stored login.

Without a stored login, without a linked workspace, or when a refresh or a re-mint fails, every frame gets a terminal reporter_not_configured NACK and nothing is posted. The reporter reads the stored login only after it denied process inspection, and no answer or diagnostic carries a credential.
